item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 8 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 8 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 17 August 2026(Monday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, San Antonio, Castillejos, San Felipe, San Narciso, San Marcelino), Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol), Bulacan(Hagonoy, Calumpit, Paombong, Malolos, Bulakan, Meycauayan, Obando, Marilao) and Metro Manila(Navotas, Malabon, Valenzuela, Caloocan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Botolan, Cabangan, Candelaria, Iba, Masinloc, Palauig, Santa Cruz), Pampanga(Porac, Guagua, Santa Rita, Minalin, Apalit), Metro Manila(Quezon City, Las Pinas, Muntinlupa, Paranaque, Taguig, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Pasay, Pateros, Marikina, Manila), Bulacan(Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria), Rizal(Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Tanay, Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Morong, Taytay, Teresa), Cavite(General Trias, Maragondon, Ternate, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Cavite City, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza, Magallanes) and Batangas(Nasugbu, Calatagan, Lian, Tuy, Balayan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bulacan(San Ildefonso, Angat, Baliuag, Bustos, Norzagaray, Pandi, San Rafael), Pampanga(Angeles, Mabalacat, Bacolor, San Fernando, Mexico, Santo Tomas, San Luis, San Simon, Candaba, Santa Ana, Arayat, Magalang), Tarlac(San Clemente, Camiling, Mayantoc, Santa Ignacia, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Rizal(Pililla, Jala-Jala), Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Indang, Mendez, Tagaytay, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Silang), Laguna(Binan, Santa Rosa, San Pedro), Batangas(Laurel, Lemery, Calaca, Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Batangas City, Bauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lobo, Mabini, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Taal, Taysan, Tingloy, Talisay, Padre Garcia) and Quezon(Agdangan, Alabat, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan, Padre Burgos, Atimonan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Burdeos, Jomalig, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo), Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan, Cabuyao, Calamba), Bulacan(San Miguel, Dona Remedios Trinidad), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada) and Batangas(Balete, Tanauan, Lipa, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Santo Tomas) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
